items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So Donald Harrison and Branford Marsalis and all those cats.

ctx.x: Yeah, he teaches those cats double lip. So Donald Harrison and Branford Marsalis and all those cats.

Oh yeah. You get a beautiful sound. You really do, much because your teeth are not on the mouthpiece. Because my teeth used to be beautiful. I was fooling around. The minute I started blowing with these Link mouthpieces . . .
